payout_quote: For each New Friend that opens and funds an Eligible Account, up to five (5) New Friends per calendar year, the Referrer will receive a $50 Referral Reward deposited into their Referrer Account within thirty (30) days.
steps: Be a current Ally Bank customer; find your unique Personal Link in Profile & Settings > Personal Information (or via the referral button in the mobile app)
Share the link with a friend who is new to Ally (no Ally Bank deposit account since Jan 1, 2024)
Friend enrolls via your link, opens an eligible account (Savings or Spending) and funds it with any amount (trial deposits do not count)
You receive a $50 Referral Reward in your Ally account within 30 days
catches: Cap: up to 5 successful referrals per calendar year ($250/year max)
Excluded friends: anyone with an existing or recent (since Jan 1, 2024) Ally Bank deposit account earns you nothing
Your Referrer Account must be open and in good standing when the reward is paid
Friend must enroll, open, and fund with real money — trial deposits do not count
Bonuses may be taxable and reported on an IRS tax form
Program offered through December 31, 2026 (subject to early termination at Ally's sole discretion)
Some customers report the referral link only appears when their account is eligible for the program — check Profile & Settings; the standard terms do not require an invitation
biggest_catch: You only get paid for 5 referrals a year ($250 max) — and your friend must actually fund the account with real money, not just open it.
eligibility: Current Ally Bank customers with an account in good standing; referred friends must be new-to-Ally (no deposit account since Jan 1, 2024)
timing: $50 deposited within 30 days after friend completes enrollment, opening, and funding

notes: Ally Bank refer-a-friend: $50 per successful referral (friend enrolls via Personal Link, opens Savings/Spending account, funds with any real amount), capped at 5 per calendar year ($250). Program runs through Dec 31, 2026. Note: some users report the Personal Link only appears for program-eligible accounts; standard terms describe it as available to current Ally Bank customers.
payout_value_note: $50 cash per referral deposited into the referrer's Ally account; cap 5/year.
numeric_basis: payout from official ally.com terms ($50 per referral); time: sharing Personal Link est. 5-15 min active
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $50 deposited within 30 days after friend completes enrollment, opening, and funding — the program's payout window runs up to 30 days after qualification.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 30-day payout window is the binding constraint after qualification — nothing in the terms shortens it; compress the qualification leg instead.
Volume constraint noted in terms: Cap: up to 5 successful referrals per calendar year ($250/year max)', 'Excluded fri — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
